127414.overview: Twilight Zone is a widebody pinball machine, designed by Pat Lawlor and based on the TV series of the same name. It was first released in 1993 by Midway (under the Bally label).

149968.overview:
Battle the Genie, rescue the princess, and explore the tales of the Arabian Nights in this 1990s classic pinball machine.

This is another great game by John Popadiuk Jr. It is clearly inspired by his earlier success, Theatre of Magic. The difficulty level is about the same; even though it is much easier to progress through the modes and reach the final mode, the playfield is more difficult. The game is based on the Arabian Nights, of course, with a Lamp, a Genie, and a flying carpet ramp. It has a beautiful and detailed backglass.

Surprisingly, it is a very low scoring game. Williams seems to have done what Mexico did a few year ago, and chop three zeroes off their "currency". Scores are about one thousand times less than Attack from Mars. Replay is usually around 10-20 million, high scores around 40 million or so, anything over 100 million is a world-class score. Highest score I've ever seen is over one billion! The font for the high scores is the same as AFM, there's a lot of empty space where the billions would have been. The game rolls over at one billion, good luck getting there...

Another unique thing about Tales of the Arabian Nights (TOTAN) is that it goes out of its way to tell players free games are available. Instead of "Replay at..." it flashes "Free game at..." at the start of the last ball. During Match, it tells the players that a free game is possible if they match. This is a good feature for people new to pinball, who might not know about the Match feature.

178188.overview:
Tom and Jerry...A game of cat and mouse!

Remember coming home after school, or sitting in front of the TV on Saturday morning with your favorite bowl of cereal, and watching this classic? It's been almost 80 years since this hilarious cat and mouse duo debuted, and they've finally made their way to VPX! Now, you can "play" the cartoon and re-live all of those fond memories right at your fingertips! 

Tom & Jerry have literally invaded your pinball table and that's just the beginning. You'll help Jerry collect all of his cheese, challenge Tom to a Pin"brawl", and encounter many other zany surprises! There's no stopping these two in this fun and exciting adventure!

196230.overview:
The lost colony of Alterra is a completely man-made world in a nearby galaxy, abandoned long ago. Alterra consists of five self-contained habitats, separately bio-engineered by a powerful ecosystem generation network known as a multiple organism unit link, or MORGUL for short. Early colonists used MORGUL to render Alterra habitable, but a cataclysmic earthquake severed all system interface functions, and MORGUL murderously rebelled. The few colonists lucky enough to escape told a grim tale of a higher intelligence gone berserk.

For generations, mankind sought a return to Alterra. Finally, genetic science created a saviou: Turrican, a mutant warrior, bio-engineered for the task of planetary reclamation. In the meantime, MORGUL has diligently twisted Alterran life forms to his brutal, destructive purposes. With your pinball skills can you help Turrican eliminate hostile organisms from Alterra's five multi-level world and, finally, destroy the three faces of MORGUL?

Turrican is a table for Visual Pinball X based on the early 1990s run and gun video game franchise of the same name. It is a re-themed version of Onevox's digital table "The Flash" (Original, 2018), which itself was an adaptation of JP Salas' recreation of the physical pinball table "Flash" (Williams, 1979). It features Chris Huelsbeck's legendary Turrican music and can be played by up to four players.

200596.overview:
Travel through time in this classic pinball table. Shift between past, present and future - each era brings unique challenges, scoring modes and excitement. Fast paced gameplay, retro visuals and timeless gamplay awaits!

Released in January 1983, Time Machine is a standout "Generation 2" solid-state pinball table from the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria. It is widely celebrated for its innovative mechanical "time travel" gimmick and striking visuals. 

The artwork blends science fiction tropes, featuring a "bald scientist," futuristic silver towers, and prehistoric elements. The game casts the player as the assistant to the unnamed scientist, who has invented a Time Machine. The backglass incorporates neon lighting and an infinity mirror effect in the center, which was highly advanced for 1983.

The table features a unique "transforming" playfield that shifts the game between two distinct eras:

● The Future: The game begins in this era. The main playfield features a raised circular platform containing three pop bumpers. Players aim for specific standup targets (A-B-C-D-E-F) to build the "Future Bonus".

● The Past: Entering the Time Hole saucer triggers the "Time Machine." The circular platform retracts into the table, and the pop bumpers disappear below the surface. In this mode, players must hit a row of seven numbered targets at the back of the table to build the "Past Bonus" and light the Green Special.

Approximately 2,400 units were manufactured. Due to its unique custom parts (like the moving platform and 3D backglass), original machines are difficult to find in working condition and hard to restore.

460482.overview: Time Machine (LTD do Brasil) is a rare Brazilian-produced solid-state pinball machine released in 1984. It features artwork inspired by Atari's Middle Earth (1978) and a playfield layout based on Williams' Time Fantasy (1983).

460485.overview: Trick Shooter is a solid-state pinball machine manufactured by LTD do Brasil in 1980. It is known for being a "clone" of Game Plan's 1979 classic, Sharpshooter, sharing a nearly identical western-themed playfield layout and ruleset.

468513.overview:
Thor is one of the four Marvel pinball tables released as part of the Vengeance and Virtue pack, and is the fourth and final table in that pack to be released in late 2011, available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3.

Based on a fictional version of the famous god of thunder in Norse mythology of the same name, created by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Jack Kirby, this table explores his valiant efforts to master his incredible lightning powers and potent strength to defend his home realm of Asgard from dangerous threats, including the treachery of his mischevious stepbrother frost giant Loki, the ice demon Ymir and the powerful sentient Destroyer armor that Loki sometimes hijacks.

Despite being released on the same year Paramount Pictures released a film adaptation of the character set in the early years of Disney's Marvel Cinematic Universe, this table solely draws on his original depiction in the comics.

468558.overview:
This table adapts the events of the 2016 film of the same name and its sequel, depicting the Trolls' journey into the wild and their discovery of music through the 6 Strings.

Released as part of the Dreamworks Pinball pack for Zen Pinball Party for Apple Arcade on 3 September 2021, and subsequently released as DLC for Pinball FX on 15 December 2022.

As DreamWorks is currently owned by Universal Pictures, this table pack was produced as a continuation of Zen Studios' partnership with the firm following the Universal Pictures Classics mini-table pack.

468566.overview: Tesla was one of the first four pinball tables available in Zen Pinball when it first released for the PlayStation 3, ported to later releases of the Pinball FX series as DLC. It is based on the inventions and works of Nikolai Tesla.

468670.overview:
Embark on a globe-spanning pinball journey, reliving Lara Croft’s most legendary adventures. Face iconic enemies, explore ancient temples, and collect mythical artifacts in this action-packed pinball table!

Tomb Raider Pinball is packed with adventure, nostalgia, and high-score thrills. Adventure awaits... are you ready?

468671.overview:
Step inside Lara Croft’s ancestral home, where adventure awaits behind every corner. Train for Lara’s next expedition, explore hidden rooms, and uncover the manor’s deepest secrets!

Tomb Raider Pinball is packed with adventure, nostalgia, and high-score thrills. Adventure awaits... are you ready?

468996.overview: The race for taming the Red Planet has begun! Run one of the mega-corporations and use your pinball skills to raise the oxygen level, heat up the planet, and create vast oceans on your way to the top of the leaderboards.

469222.overview:
Life's a beach! Ride waves, hit coconuts and soak in the island vibes on this sunny paradise table.

This electro-mechanical pinball machine from 1974 was the first ever table produced by the Zaccaria brothers (Marino, Franco, and Natale) in Bologna, Italy. 

The table is so rare today that it wasn't added as DLC to the digital Zaccaria Pinball collection until 20 June 2018, two years after the base game was released, as the developers Magic Pixel had been unable to find an actual physical table to examine.

469425.overview:
Go all-in! Poker chips, card flips, and skill shots decide your fate at this high-stakes pinball table.

Top Hand is an electromechanical pinball table manufactured by the Italian company Zaccaria in 1974.

469555.overview:
Put on the mask and rev the chainsaw - Leatherface returns to slaughter in pinball form! Aim your shots and use all your skills to take out your victims in one of the most brutal pinball tables ever created.

Table features:

- Play as Leatherface and terrorize the new arrivals who dare come into your town
- Sneak up on unsuspecting victims by shooting the right targets to maim and massacre them
- It's a Bloodbath in the Bus! Lock 3 balls then watch the mayhem unfold
- RNN RRNNN RRRNNN! Keep revving the chainsaw to start a frenzy mode for increased points
- Complete all Main Modes to face off against the last survivors in Wizard Mode. Don't let anyone escape!

469559.overview:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling and suspenseful world of Universal Pictures' 1982 classic film - The Thing. Use your pinball skills and battle against the shape-shifting alien through the arctic chill of U.S. Outpost #31. Can you trust anyone, even yourself? 

Chilling table features: 

- Survive the vicious attack of the Dog-Thing by shooting its tentacles.
- It’s Bennings! Watch him transform and torch what he becomes.
- You know you’re human, and some of your crew are still human too. Collect blood samples and shoot the reagent cartridge to reveal the impostor.
- We found something in the ice! Lock, then bust open the balls for BURIED IN ICE multi-ball.
- Rig your TNT to blow up the base and The Thing in a wild Wizard Mode. Why don’t you just… see what happens?

470435.overview:
Travel through the ages with every shot! Spin the gears of history, trigger epic events and master time itself in this thrilling pinball adventure across past, present, and future.

Time Machine Deluxe is a digital reimagining by Magic Pixel of the 1983 solid-state Zaccaria table with modern pinball features such as LCD display, prism lamps and game and multiball modes. It was released as DLC in 2025 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470436.overview:
Island paradise renewed! Bright beaches, palm trees, and sunny shots keep the tropical fun going strong.

Tropical 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1974 electromechanical Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470437.overview:
Island paradise upgraded! Brighter colors, smoother flow, and deluxe sunny fun keep the party going.

This table is a modernized version of Zaccaria's original Tropical table from 1974 and brings a vibrant beach theme to life with updated visuals and dynamic gameplay. Catch waves, soak up the sun, and rack up points with features like ball save, kickback, sunshine bonus, and the thrilling multiball mode. 

Tropical Deluxe offers four exciting modes—Beach, Surf, Bar, and Sea—plus four mini games including Pool, Slip, Seaside, and Beach. With combos, crab bonuses, multipliers, and special modes like Tropical Mode and Bay Bonus, this table captures the carefree spirit of a summer getaway while honoring the charm of its retro roots.

470439.overview:
The time-travel saga continues! More eras, more modes, and even faster gameplay in this updated classic.

Time Machine 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1983 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

472470.overview: ThunderCats was a popular animated television series, running from 1985 to 1989. This original table for Future Pinball was released in April 2006 and features artwork from the show and the classic theme song (on a loop!).

473077.overview: This Future Pinball mod of Stern's 1979 solid-state classic adds music and different sound effects to give it a more modern feel. The original table is known for its striking aquatic fantasy theme loosely based on Neptune, the God of the Sea.

474084.overview: SLAMT1LT's ULTIMATE mod of his own Skynet mod of one of the greatest pinball machines ever made has all new music, sound, video, lighting and visual effects, but the same classic gameplay and artwork of Williams' 1991 table.

474440.overview: Total Recall is an original table based on the iconic 1990 sci-fi action movie starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Created by independent developers within the Future Pinball community, this digital table brings the dystopian world of Mars, memory implants, and mutant rebellions to life. Featuring gritty, futuristic neon aesthetics and custom-rendered models, the table uses sound clips, movie dialogue, and the intense orchestral score by Jerry Goldsmith to drive the gameplay immersion.

474975.overview:
JP's Terminator 3 was released for Visual Pinball X in 2020, closely recreating Stern's original 2003 table layout and artwork, using playfield graphics taken from a Stern prototype. It then received a significant graphical mod from Siggi in 2023, with new graphics for the playfield, plastics, backwall, sidewalls and apron, completely changing the look of the table. This was the table Stern should have released in 2003!

So significant was Siggi's mod, that it has served as the foundation for other T3 mods released for VPX, including a 2024 table update by TastyWasps, which was then itself modded by Bord in 2025 to add VLM rendered lighting.

477367.overview:
Based on the 2010 Disney movie, TRON Legacy was released by SLAMT1LT for Future Pinball in 2011. Though Stern released a pinball machine with the same name that year, this digital table is a completely different game.

The rules follow the events in the movie.

The GRID: 

Enter the Grid by completing T-R-O-N to open the Arcade.  Shoot the kicker under the TRON Arcade Cabinet to enter the Grid.

ID Disc:

Shoot the ramp 4 times to open the Armoury and then shoot the Armoury Kicker to aquire your ID Disc.  You can now proceed to games.

Disc Wars:

Complete L-E-G-A-C-Y and shoot the Games Kicker to start Disc Wars.  A virtual upper playfield will appear.  Get the ball to the end without touching the sides of the Arena to win.  Knock down all the Disc Warriors to get a big bonus.  If you fail you wil have to restart the mode again.  The Disc Wars game mode will remain active until the Light Cycle Mode is activated, meaning you can compete as many times as you like for massive points.

Light Cycle Battle:

Complete 5 End of Line Orbits and then shoot the Games Kicker to start the Light Cycle Battle.  The entire playfield will change to the Light Cycle Arena (the backglass art also changes).  6 Balls will be launched into play.  The objective is to knock the balls into the Armoury Kicker or the Games Kicker to destroy the bikers.  The 2nd to last ball must also be destroyed, not drained, to win.

Zuse:

Find Zuse by locking a ball into each kicker - TRON Arcade Kicker, Armoury Kicker and Games Kicker.  This starts a 3 ball multiball mode and plays the famous Daft Punk dance theme.  Targets will appear on the playfield, knock them down for Jackpots and shoot the ramp to increase the Jackpot multiplier.

The Portal:

60 second multiball based on Indy's Eternal Life Mode.  Hit the lit targets for 1 Million points each.  Get them all for 1 Billion points and finish the game by entering the Portal.

CLU Ball:

Hit the 3 CLU targets to start the CLU Power Discs ( the Bumpers).  Hit the Power Discs a certain number of times to light the CLU Start Light.  Hit the Armoury to Start CLU Ball.  The normal play ball is held captive while a new ball (CLU) is launched onto the playfield.  Hit the CLU Targets again to start the CLU Power Discs.  Hitting the Power Discs a certain number of times will light the Games Kicker.  Hit it to aquire Flynn's Disc and gain a massive points bonus.  CLU Ball can be activated at anytime after you enter the Grid.

BIT Multiplier:

Hitting all the BIT targets and rollovers will increase the Bonus Mulitplier.   When Bonus x 10 is reached, a random Bonus Feature is awarded.  These awards range from 10 Million Points to an Extra Ball.   This Bonus Award feature will continue until the ball is lost and the Multipliers are reset.

SkillShot:

Obtained when the ball is first launched.  Get it by hitting the ball with the left upper flipper and completing an End of Line Orbit.

477449.overview: Gottleib's classic 1976 sci-fi themed electro-mechanical table receives a number of digital upgrades in this "Ultimate" version. SLAMT1LT has taken Popotte's recreation for Future Pinball and added new audio callouts, new in-game music, Babylon Zoo's "Spaceman" as the attract music, and even a space fighter plane that flies over the playfield to drop the ball into play.

479222.overview:
This Future Pinball tribute to Stern's 2011 table closely models the layout, shots, and artwork of the real-world Stern physical pinball machine. Developed by community legends SLAMT1LT and ROM, it enhances the standard table with a full colour video screen instead of a DMD, custom sound effects, music arrangements, and video clips tailored for the virtual platform.

As with the physical table, players must choose to represent the Autobots or the Decepticons at the start of the game. Depending on the side chosen, the ball 'transforms' into a different colour in this VIP version, and players can select between one of three different backglasses using Special Key 1. Whichever side you choose, your main objective is to defeat the enemy.  So if you choose the Autobots, you will first have to defeat all the Decepticons before facing Sentinal Prime.  When Sentinal Prime is beaten, then you play the modes for your own side.  

Both Megatron and Optimus Prime Multiball Modes are activated by locking 3 balls into the Megatron Canon. Duel Multiball (an exclusive mode for Future Pinball) is activated when the Optimus Prime toy is hit a certain number of times.  2 balls are launched into play to start the mode but hit the Megatron Kicker and Megatron will clone himself using Dark Energon and fire 2 balls back!  Hit Optimus Prime for the Jackpots.

Some modes have been improved over the Stern original.  Bumblebee now requires you to hit the Captive Ball Car a certain number of times.  Devastator Mode requires you to hit the Bumper a certain number of times and Starscream Mode will activate the Canon Blaster and every hit to the small targets will fire the Canon.

Skillshots are the top left rollover lanes (drop the ball into the lit lane) and the kicker behind Megatron (a soft launch will make this shot).

The green 'X' lights will flash when all lights for the Decepticons or Autobots have been lit (depending on the side you're playing).  Hit any flashing X light to increase the Bonus Multiplier and add Multiplier Scoring for that shot for the rest of the ball.  For instance, if the Left Ramp is hit when the green 'X' light is on, the score is multiplied by the current muiltiplier.

Another Future Pinball exclusive feature is the Energon Bonus.  When the ball hits the kicker behind Megatron, the player is awarded an Energon Bonus which increases with each hit.

479952.overview:
Team America: World Police is an adult-themed release for Visual Pinball X. Based on the famous 2004 satirical puppet movie by the creators of South Park, this community-made table is packed with crude humor, over-the-top patriotism, and explosive action.

A satire of action film archetypes, American militarism, and the foreign policy of the United States, the movie follows the eponymous international counterterrorism force, which recruits a Broadway actor to assist in saving the world from Kim Jong Il and his coalition of Islamic terrorists and progressive Hollywood actors.

The table layout is adapted from Bally's 1976 "Freedom" pinball machine, and the game features high-quality video clips via a PuP-Pack, direct soundbites, and the iconic, explicit theme songs from the movie.

480198.overview: Terminator for Future Pinball is a simple, original table with a stylized caricature of Arnold Schwarzenegger as the only imagery of the playfield. The table is actually surpisingly atmospheric, with the music suitably matching the austere color scheme of silver, red and black.

480501.overview:
Truxton Pinball: ULTRA Edition is SLAMT1LT's mod of an original game released by Propst Pinball in 2006 for Future Pinball. The game is based on the vertical shoot-em-up Truxton 2 (Toaplan, 1992). In addition to the artwork and sound of Truxton 2 being used for this table, the gameplay itself is also influenced by 2D shoot-em-ups.

The main goal is to beat the big end-of-level boss, depicted on the plastic above the bumpers. To get that far, you first have to beat some sub-bosses, and this is done by dropping the targets on the right side of the playfield. This will light locks on the left side, and once the third ball is in the lock, the multiball boss fight will start. You harm the boss by hitting the bumpers, but only while more than one ball is in play. The top bumper does the main damage, so this is the key do beating the boss, and this is also typically the most-scoring target in regular play.

Two other regular shoot-em-up features are also important in this game: smartbombs and power-ups. Lit bombs means the kickback in the left outlane is lit, and unless the machine is set to hard, you can have up to three of these stored. You light bombs by completing the top rollovers. The center targets are for collecting power-ups. There are three types, color-coded: red, blue and green. You collect a power-up when all three lights of the same color are lit, and this will light all features of the same color on the playfield. The lit features score much more than when in the basic state, and this way you choose which set of features to light (only one can be lit at a time, as you can only have one of the three powerup types).

480647.overview:
An original table for Future Pinball based on the British science fiction television series created by Gerry Anderson. The TV series was filmed between 1964 and 1966 using a form of electronic marionette puppetry called "Supermarionation" combined with scale model special effects sequences. 

Thunderbirds follows the exploits of the Tracy family, headed by American industrialist and ex-astronaut Jeff Tracy. Jeff is a widower with five adult sons: Scott, John, Virgil, Gordon and Alan. The Tracys make up International Rescue, a secret organisation founded to save human life. They are aided in this mission by technologically advanced land, sea, air and space vehicles that are called into service when conventional rescue methods prove ineffective. The most important of these vehicles are the five "Thunderbird machines", each assigned to one of the five Tracy brothers.

480775.overview:
Step into the world of Tomb Raider: A Survivor Is Born with this thrilling, action-packed Tomb Raider table for Visual Pinball X! Inspired by the 2013 reboot, the game puts you in control of a young Lara Croft, stranded on the mysterious island of Yamatai, where survival means facing brutal enemies, ancient puzzles, and deadly environments. Use your pinball skills to help Lara defeat her enemies and get back home. Survive the island. Uncover the mystery. Become the Tomb Raider!

Released by Ivan TBA in 2019 under the title of "Tomb Raider: A Survival is Born" rather than the correct tagline of "A Survivor is Born", this table is a re-theme of Devil's Dare (Gottlieb, 1982).

480888.overview: First released in 2018, with version 2.0 released in 2022, TRON: Classic is a graphics and sound mod of Panthera (Gottlieb, 1980) for Visual Pinball X based on the classic 1982 Disney sci-fi film, TRON.

480946.overview:
In 2005, the evil Decepticons have conquered the Autobots' home planet of Cybertron. The heroic Autobots, operating from Cybertron's two moons, prepare a counteroffensive. The Autobot leader, Optimus Prime, sends a shuttle to Autobot City on Earth for supplies. The Decepticons discover their plan, kill several Autobots, and hijack the ship. Use your pinball skills to help the Autobots defeat the Decepticons and save Cybertron.

Based on the 1986 Transformers movie, Ivan TBA's table for Visual Pinball X is a mod of Defender (Williams, 1982).

480997.overview:
Ivan TBA's The Thing is a re-theme of Ali (Stern, 1980) for Visual Pinball X. The table is based on the influential cult science fiction horror film, directed by the master of the horror genre, John Carpenter.

The Thing is about a group of American researchers in Antarctica who encounter the eponymous "Thing", an extraterrestrial life-form that assimilates, then imitates, other organisms. The group is overcome by paranoia and conflict as they learn that they can no longer trust each other and that any of them could be the Thing. 

The movie stars Kurt Russell as the team's helicopter pilot R. J. MacReady, with a score partly provided by Carpenter himself, and partly by legendary film composer Ennio Morricone. 

The music that is played in-game can be changed by editing the script in Visual Pinball; change "The Thing ost music.mp3" to ---> "The Thing metal music.mp3".

481107.overview:
The Texas Chain Saw Massacre (1974), directed by Tobe Hooper, is a groundbreaking American horror film that fundamentally reshaped the slasher genre. Shot on a shoestring budget with a cast of relatively unknown actors, the movie presents itself as a dramatization of true events, though it is only loosely inspired by the crimes of real-life murderer Ed Gein. Upon its release, its gritty, documentary-style cinematography and intense atmosphere shocked audiences and critics alike, leading to it being banned in several countries while simultaneously becoming a massive box-office success.

The plot follows five young friends—Sally Hardesty, her paraplegic brother Franklin, and their companions Jerry, Kirk, and Pam—who are road-tripping through rural Texas to visit a vandalized family gravesite. After picking up and quickly ejecting a deeply disturbing hitchhiker, the group runs low on fuel and stops near an abandoned homestead. One by one, they wander into a neighboring house looking for gasoline, only to be ambushed by a cannibalistic family of outcasts, led by the towering, human-skin-mask-wearing killer known as Leatherface.

The final act deconstructs into pure survival horror, focusing on Sally as the sole survivor of the initial onslaught. She is captured and subjected to a psychological nightmare during a grotesque family dinner scene before managing a desperate, blood-soaked escape. Celebrated for its masterful use of suggestion—relying heavily on dread, piercing sound design, and frantic editing rather than excessive on-screen gore—the film remains a towering masterpiece of cinema that pioneered staples like the "final girl" trope and the use of power tools as weapons.

Ivan TBA's pinball tribute to the film was released for Visual Pinball X in 2020, and is a re-theme of Nautilus (Playmatic, 1984).

482099.overview: SLAMT1LT's Ultimate Edition of Data East's 1993 table adds a video screen to the backglass, additional sound effects, several toys, and an optional 'Thriller' mode, which adds the hook from the Michael Jackson classic at the end of each ball.
